notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 8/15
notes.content: [p]Today we're deploying an update to the PTS. You can find the patch notes below.[/p][p][/p][h1]C.A.M.P.[/h1][p][/p][p align="start"]After our PTS update on 8/13 we saw reports that some C.A.M.P.S. were still having an overbudget issue when compared to the C.A.M.P. on the live server. We made an adjustment in today’s patch so those C.A.M.P.S. should no longer have this issue.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]If you were affected by this, please login and let us know if your C.A.M.P. budget issue was fixed![/p][p][/p][h1]Workshop[/h1][list][*][p]Various bug fixes to door lock UI - it should be fully functional so let us know if something is wrong.[/p][/*][*][p]More bug fixes to Replace feature UI.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Known Issues[/h1][list][*][p]We're aware of an issue with filters with this update causing the feature to not function as expected. We're on it!.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 8/13
notes.content: [p]Today we have deployed an update to the Public Test Server. Please read on below for the patch notes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Item Locking[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Players can now lock and unlock items in their stash when accessed via the My C.A.M.P. Device.[/p][/*][*][p]Power Armor pieces will now keep their Locked/Unlocked status when added to or removed from a Power Armor Chassis.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]V.A.T.S[/b][/h3][p align="start"]With today’s PTS update we’re making some additional changes to how V.A.T.S. calculates Hit Chance. We’re making these changes with the intention of allowing certain buffs, mods and perks to have more of an effect on improving Hit Chance.[/p][list][*][p]Perception now provides a larger benefit to hit chance.[/p][/*][*][p]Recoil and cone of fire now play a more prominent role in deciding hit chance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Workshop[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Items should now rotate in the same direction as they do on the live servers (sorry about that, we never meant to swap those!)[/p][/*][*][p]We've tamed the experience of using controller bumpers to scroll through categories. No longer will that scroll run free.[/p][/*][*][p]Placement error messages should now properly clear.[/p][/*][*][p]The menu now remembers which mode you were in when you re-enter it.[/p][/*][*][p]“New” category will now show one entry per new item purchased or unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Items in “New” category can now properly be placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Various bugfixes around the Replace functionality - including instances of the cursor jumping to the top of the list.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 8/1
notes.content: [h3][b]C.A.M.P.[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where players were unable to put items back in Aid Box after removing them.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Combat[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the description for the Executioner's legendary mod.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Tenderizer Salty and Peppered mods:[/p][list][*][p]Salty now adds Armor Penetration.[/p][/*][*][p]Peppered adds Limb Damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Rad Sponge point cost was increased to 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Grim Reapers Spring that caused it to not work on every kill.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Kneecapper and Heavy Hitter's that caused them to not operate as they were described.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Workshop[/b][/h3][p]Over the course of this PTS we’ve rolled out a lot of changes to help give the new Workshop UI a solid foundation for all C.A.M.P. builders in the Wasteland. Today's update includes some behind-the-scenes updates, in addition to what's below, to make sure things are solid.[/p][p]We need you to jump in, build, browse, and see what breaks! Your feedback is important. Please report any bugs, odd behavior, or suggestions through our channels in the [url="https://discord.gg/bethesdagamestudio"]Bethesda Game Studios Discord[/url].[/p][p]Thank you and happy building![/p][list][*][p]The correct number of stored items now displays properly on Workshop items.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother Navigation:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed flickering when expanding item categories.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where variant lists showed data from previously selected items.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]History subcategories now update correctly when changes occur.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed crashes in Workshop Build Mode related to item selection.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 7/31
notes.content: [p]Hey Everyone, today the team is deploying an update to the Public Test Server. You can find today's patch notes below.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Combat[/b][/h3][p][b]Miscellaneous Combat Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Executioner's legendary mod now is an additive damage boost instead of multiplicative.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the range and ammo capacity for the Cryolator's Crystallizing Barrel.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue where players couldn't deal self-radiation damage with the Gamma Gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Bomb Scientist where it would work with weapons other than thrown grenades.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapon Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addressed an issue where players couldn't deal self radiation damage with the Gamma Gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unintended range, recoil, etc. effects from the standard barrel mod for the V63 Laser Carbine.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Enemy Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Revert a couple of unintended health changes for the Ultragenetic Deathclaw and Ultragenetic Mole Miner Stalker (Raids)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the health and resistances of the EN06 Guardian (Raids)[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Poison damage immunity from Super Mutants and Robobrains[/p][list][*][p]Super mutants are still highly resistant to Poison damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted Super Mutant resistances.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mod Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Executioner's legendary mod now is an additive damage boost instead of multiplicative.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the range and ammo capacity for the Cryolator's Crystallizing Barrel mod.[/p][/*][*][p]The Minigun Shredder mod no-longer benefits from the Radioactive Strength perk.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed an unintended damage bonus from the Laser Gun and Ultracite Laser Gun Aligned Automatic Barrel mods.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing Cryo damage on the Freezing mod for the Electro Enforcer[/p][/*][*][p]Mods which convert weapons from semi-auto to automatic:[/p][list][*][p]Shots to max recoil: +150% -> +250%[/p][/*][*][p]Removed 25% penalty to recoil recovery speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Now increases minimum cone of fire by 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Delay before cone of fire recovery: +35% -> +15%[/p][/*][*][p]Cone of fire increase per shot: -15% -> -35%[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Item Locking[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The new setting to allow or block the use of locked consumables should now be working as expected.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Mischief Night[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Lost have put on their Halloween costumes to join the spooky festivities.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve made changes that we believe will help the overall performance of the event. Please let us know how it goes![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Workshop[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Replace Mode[/b]: You can now swap out placed items without needing to scrap and rebuild. Making C.A.M.P. customization smoother and faster.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Missing Icons[/b]: Visual indicators for key camp elements have returned, helping you quickly identify “what’s what” in the subcategory variants lists.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blueprint Selection Fixes[/b]: We’ve resolved inconsistencies when selecting blueprints, so your saved layouts should behave more predictably.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Scrapping bug to disable scrapping when nothing is selected.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 7/25
notes.content: [h3][b]Combat[/b][/h3][p][b]Miscellaneous Combat Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Gamma Gun Deep Dish mod projectile didn't deal Radiation damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed some inconsistencies with how Pipe Syringer mods changed the weapon's range.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the speed of the Plasma Caster projectile by 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the speed of the Alien Disintegrator High-Powered Receiver projectile by 100%[/p][/*][*][p]Re-implemented fix for Crossbow Prime Receiver range[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing damage increase for the Flamer (32 -> 42)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Laser Splitter mods where they increased damage more than intended.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hellstorm Missile Launcher Damage Increase[/b][/p][list][*][p]Standard Payload: 206 Impact, 206 Explosion -> 379 Impact, 379 Explosion[/p][/*][*][p]Cryo Payload: 206 Impact, 107 Cryo Explosion -> 379 Impact, 194 Cryo Explosion[/p][/*][*][p]Napalm Payload: 206 Impact, 107 Fire Explosion, 25 Fire Damage per second for 7 seconds -> 379 Impact, 194 Fire Explosion, 25 Fire Damage per second for 7 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Plasma Payload: 206 Impact, 178 Energy Explosion -> 379 Impact, 330 Energy Explosion[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weapon Mod Range Updates[/b][/p][p]All weapons have increased base range (see below). The end result of this change is that there's slightly less contrast between Stub, Short, Medium, Long, and Sniper barrels. In particular, this helps Short and especially Stub barrels more easily compete with Long barrels. Not all range/barrel mods follow the Stub/Short/Medium/Long/Sniper naming convention, but most mods which adjust weapons' range will be adjusted similarly.[/p][list][*][p]Medium Barrel Range: +35% -> +25%[/p][/*][*][p]Long Barrel Range: +75% -> +50%[/p][/*][*][p]Sniper Barrel Range: +110% -> +75%[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Increased the Base Range of the Following Weapons[/b][/p][p]This includes unique/named/legendary variants of these weapons, which will have the same range increase as their base weapons.[/p][list][*][p]44 Revolver: 106 -> 139[/p][/*][*][p].50 Cal Machine Gun: 144 -> 182[/p][/*][*][p]10mm Submachine Gun: 95 -> 120[/p][/*][*][p]10mm: 99 -> 119[/p][/*][*][p]Alien Blaster: 99 -> 143[/p][/*][*][p]Alien Disintegrator: 148 -> 214[/p][/*][*][p]Assault Rifle: 148 -> 178[/p][/*][*][p]Auto Grenade Launcher: 182 -> 219[/p][/*][*][p]Black Powder Blunderbuss: 99 -> 148[/p][/*][*][p]Black Powder Pistol: 99 -> 148[/p][/*][*][p]Black Powder Rifle: 161 -> -> 196[/p][/*][*][p]Western Revolver: 132 -> 151[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Item Locking[/b][/h3][p]Two new toggles have been added to the Item Locking feature:[/p][list][*][p]Players can now choose if consumables (Food, Aid, Plans) can be used when locked[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now choose whether locked items can be moved between their stash and inventory[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issue[/b]: Players may run into issues with the toggle that allows consumables to be used when locked. Next week's PTS update will address those issues.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Mischief Night[/b][/h3][p]Mischief Night is back and will be running at the top hour during the PTS. Located at Rapidan Camp, we hope you enjoy this refreshed take on the fun and chaotic event.[/p][p][b]Known Issue[/b]: Melee enemies around Appalachia may appear a little lost when attempting to path towards players. During Mischief Night this will be more apparent as The Lost will now look lost when trying to hit you.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ping and Emote Mapping Swap[/b][/h3][p]Thanks to community feedback we've decided to flip the [i]Press[/i] (currently set to Ping in the live game) and [i]Press and Hold[/i] (currently set to bring up the Emote wheel in the live game) command for Ping and Emote.[/p][p]With this update, when playing with a controller, Ping can be activated by [i]Pressing and Holding[/i] the Down D-Pad button. Emote is now set to [i]Press[/i] on the Down D-Pad button.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Knee-Capper[/p][list][*][p]Removed Blunt requirement. Reduced bonus damage from 100% to 50%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Heavy Hitter[/p][list][*][p]Removed Blunt requirement. Reduced bonus damage from 50% to 25%. Reduced cost to 2 perk points[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Meat Mincer[/p][list][*][p]Changed effect to “Reduce incoming stagger by 25%.”[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bullet Storm[/p][list][*][p]Fixed ranks 2 and 3 not providing a bonus[/p][/*][*][p]Updated description and added a help menu entry[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the ammo counter not increasing for weapons such as Cremator[/p][/*][*][p]Now increments the ammo counter for additional projectiles fired[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount needed per stack from 25 to 30[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tightly Wound[/p][/*][*][p]Removed placeholder text and added the spin up faster effect -Tank Killer[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced to two ranks. Removed the stagger effect and now works with all ranged weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Stabilized[/p][/*][*][p]Changed effect to “Big guns gain 30% accuracy. Double in Power Armor.”[/p][/*][*][p]Homebody[/p][list][*][p]Added the HP and limb regen while in camps back[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Psychopath[/p][list][*][p]Reduced to a 2 point single rank card[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bloody Mess[/p][list][*][p]Removed ranks 2 and 3[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Grim Reapers Sprint[/p][list][*][p]Now a single rank that scales with luck. The effect now always restores AP on kill in VATS. The amount restored is based on your Luck and Max AP.[/p][/*][*][p]Lockpick and Hacking perks have had the Expert and Master prefix moved to be a suffix so that they sort next to each other alphabetically[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Weapons[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed display issue for explosive weapons that shot multiple projectiles[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Workbench[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Ammo crafting categories are now sorted together[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Workshop[/b][/h3][p][b]General Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed scrapping when no item was selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved inconsistencies when selecting blueprints in the workshop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where switching categories using LB/RB didn’t reset the selector to History or Dwellers as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed background elements from Blueprint Workshop icons to match the visual style of other workshop icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Flyout text now updates correctly when toggling between “Vertical Movement” and “Object Rotation” for clearer control feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues to now display Red Text for Insufficient Power.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Free Cam toggle and fixed the Exit Hold button behavior while the Blueprint Save Widget is open.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled subcategory entry when filters result in an empty subcategory.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Workshop Organization Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Moved Porch Railing to the Porch sub-menu (now only snaps to porches).[/p][/*][*][p]Moved Poisoned Earth Well to the Producers category.[/p][/*][*][p]Grouped the Thrasher with other mounted heads for better organization.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Controller / Keyboard & Mouse Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]In Modify Mode:[/p][list][*][p]LT (controller) / F (keyboard) now always jumps to Edit.[/p][/*][*][p]RT (controller) / G (keyboard) jumps to the next enabled sub mode.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]In Build Mode:[/p][list][*][p]LT / F jumps to the first subcategory (even if grayed out).[/p][/*][*][p]RT / G jumps to the next enabled subcategory.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Swapped controller bindings for Switch Mode and More Options[/b][/p][list][*][p]Xbox Controller:[/p][list][*][p]Press LS to switch between Build/Modify mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Press Menu to open/close the Options You may notice some bugs or incomplete behavior. The team is actively working on improvements and fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Inside the Vault: C.A.M.P and Combat Public Test Server - Update 7/18
notes.content: [p]Today the team deployed an update to the Public Test Server for the next major Fallout 76 patch.[/p][p]Full patch notes for this update are below.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Combat[/b][/h3][p][b]Miscellaneous Combat Balance Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a few cases of thrown weapons not scaling with player level.[/p][/*][*][p]Pain Train once-again scales its damage with player level.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Hat Trick perk to deal 70% damage per bounce instead of 80%.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Concentrated Fire perk to increase VATS hit chance for non-automatic weapons by 4/8/12% per shot (automatic is still 1/2/3%).[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the V63 Laser Carbine's AP cost back to 30 instead of 40.[/p][/*][*][p]Ultracite Ammo has returned to the contextual ammo pool.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Increased the damage of the following weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p].50 Cal Machine Gun: 42 -> 52[/p][/*][*][p]Light Machine Gun: 42 -> 47[/p][/*][*][p]Minigun: 25 -> 29[/p][/*][*][p]Gatling Gun: 103 -> 112[/p][/*][*][p]Gauss Minigun: 53 -> 59[/p][/*][*][p]Flamer: 32 -> 42[/p][/*][*][p]Plasma Caster: 87 Physical, 87 Energy -> 103 Physical, 103 Energy[/p][/*][*][p]Cryolator: 47 -> 52[/p][/*][*][p]V63 Laser Carbine: 47 -> 59[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Reduced the damage of the following weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ultracite Laser Gun: 87 -> 80[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mod Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]"True" mods now primarily improve crouching and sighted aim for weapons (highest overall precision).[/p][/*][*][p]"Stabilized" mods now increase the ability to use a weapon accurately while moving but benefit less from crouching and ADS.[/p][/*][*][p]"Aligned" mods now increase V.A.T.S. hit chance and reduce AP cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some weapon mods to be more consistent in how they change weapon durability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an unintended interaction with Plasma Gun Pulse Capacitors and Flamer Barrels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some inconsistent applications of semi-auto -> auto mod damage adjustments on Plasma Flamer mods.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Brotherhood Recon Rifle to have slightly higher damage, but higher AP cost, higher recoil, higher weight, and lower durability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Crossbow Prime Frame had much longer range than intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ultracite Laser Gun Sniper barrel mods would deal less damage than intended when fully charged.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect VFX on the V63 Laser Carbine when using the Explosive legendary mod[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments to Semi-Automatic -> Automatic Weapon Mods:[/b][/p][p]Note: This is in addition to the existing effects of these mods.[/p][list][*][p]Ammo Capacity: +30% -> +50%[/p][/*][*][p]Now reduces reload speed by 10%[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments to Large Magazines:[/b][/p][p]Note: This applies to most mods that increase ammo capacity without providing an additional effect such as quicker reloads or armor penetration.[/p][list][*][p]Ammo Capacity: +50% -> +100%[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Draw Time: +25% -> +35% (slower)[/p][/*][*][p]Reload Time: +20% -> +35% (slower)[/p][/*][*][p]Sighted Transition Time: +20% -> +35% (slower)[/p][/*][*][p]Weight: +35% -> +50%[/p][/*][*][p]Durability: -7.5% -> -10%[/p][/*][/list][p]Value has been decreased to +25% on the other ammo capacity mods (the Large Magazine mods listed above will remain at +40%)[/p][p][b]Adjustments to Hardened Receivers:[/b][/p][p]Note: This does not apply to Hardened receivers and similar mods on weapons which are automatic by default (.50 Cal Machine Gun Heavy Barrel, etc.)[/p][list][*][p]Bonus Damage: notes.title: Fallout 76 PTS: Mutation Invasion Highlights and Update Log
notes.content:
We’ve reopened the Public Test Server to share an early look at our upcoming Mutation Invasion Update for Fallout 76, which brings the Daily Op’s Mutations you’ve experienced to Appalachian Public Events! We hope you will join us in trying out these events and are very interested in your feedback and bug reports with us in the [url=http://discord.gg/BethesdaStudios]Bethesda Studios Discord Server.[/url]

[hr][/hr]

[h4]Introducing: Mutated Public Events[/h4]

Over the past four years, Appalachia has changed in many ways. While many of these changes are thanks to you (Project Clean Appalachia, anyone?) some of the changes are the results of daily long-lasting radiation exposure to the local inhabitants. Otherwise known as, “A Normal Day in the Wasteland.” 

Mutations you’ve grown to know and love from Daily Ops’ missions are now spilling over into Public Events! 
[list]
[*]At the top of the hour, every hour a Mutated Public Event will appear. These events are marked with a special icon to indicate they are Mutated. 
[*]Public Events for the remainder of the hour are normal events with no Mutations, which is also how this feature will function in the Live game. 
[/list]

As a reminder, mutations can be: 
[list]
[*][b]Volatile:[/b] Enemies explode upon death. 
[*][b]Active Camouflage:[/b] Enemies are clocked when not attacking. 
[*][b]Resilient:[/b] Enemies can only be slain with a melee attack. 
[*][b]Freezing Touch:[/b] Slow targets down upon attack. 
[*][b]Toxic Blood:[/b] Enemies leave behind small poisonous hazard upon death. 
[*][b]Group regeneration:[/b] Enemies heal each other when within radius.  
[*][b]Swift Footed:[/b] Increased movement speed. 
[/list]
 
[h3]New Rewards and Challenges![/h3]

Completing a Mutated Public Event will net you Legendary Items, Treasury Notes, and other rewards you see in a typical Public Event. In addition to these rewards, you’ll also earn a new crafting component called [b]Infusion Reagents. [/b]

[h2]Infusions[/h2]

Infusion Reagents can be combined at your Chemistry Workbench to create a new consumable item: Infusions! 
[list]
[*]Infusions have powerful effects that last for a short amount of time. 
[*]Each Infusion has multiple tiers that increase the magnitude and/or duration of their effects. 
[*]Unlock higher Infusion Tiers by completing new Lifetime Challenges for Mutated Public Events. The more Mutated Events you complete, the more tiers you unlock! 
[/list]

[h2]Infusion Details[/h2]

Currently, there are two infusions you can try out: 
[list]
[*][b]Steel Skin Infusion:[/b] Gain the effects of wearing Power Armor for several minutes. 
[*][b]Healing Cloud Infusion:[/b] Emit a Healing Cloud that heals you and other friendly nearby players for several minutes. 
[/list]

[h2]Additional Rewards[/h2]

[b]Mutated Package[/b]

Similar to Treasure Pails and Holiday Gifts, Mutated Packages contain a host of rewards, from contextual ammo, Infusion Reagents, and a chance for rare plans, serums and Legendary Weapons. 

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Earn more rewards with Fallout 1st![/h3]

When participating in a Mutated Public Event with Fallout 1st members present, everyone earns more rewards! Regardless of if you are subscribed or not, all event attendees will earn increased rewards. “The more the merrier” as we say, meaning if enough Fallout 1st members are present, the rewards increase. 

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Daily Ops Improvements[/h2]

In addition to Mutated Public Events, we’ve also added new locations, enemies and a new mutation into our Daily Ops rotation. We’d love to hear your feedback on this new encounter group and mutation in our Discord. 

[h3]Daily Ops[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Mutation:[/b] Reflective Skin 
[list]
[*][b]Reflective Skin:[/b] Enemies periodically enter a Reflective state that reflects back some of the damage done to them. 
[*]Reflective Skin will also be on our Mutated Public Events list. [/list]
[*][b]New Encounter group:[/b] Aliens 
[*][b]New Locations:[/b]
[list]
  [*] Capitol Building 
  [*] Garrahan Mining Headquarters 
  [*] Morgantown High School 
[/list]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Thank you very much for your participation in the PTS, we’re looking forward to hearing what you think!
